verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents general contract workflows: a no-code contract builder, approval routing via integrations, and e-signature. Nothing in the evidence covers board consents, resolutions, or collecting board approvals for corporate governance or fundraising. Generic contract-workflow features are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this specific story.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can prepare board consents and resolutions and collect approvals online
